Corpus

79 graphs, every one a file you can cook

Every graph in graphs/, cooked in the editor and shot from the frame it draws into. 65 basics, 6 examples, 8 pipeline. Each file teaches one thing and cooks from JSON alone — pcg cook graphs/<name>.json reproduces what you see here from the seed the file carries, on any machine and in any cook order.

Hover a card for the node graph behind the frame. Click to open it in the editor and change it live. The files themselves are in graphs/; the same index in prose is graphs.md.
